'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matthew Gountis DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matthew Gountis]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Matt Gountis
* '''Deck name:''' Black Sun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
